scripts.dev:local: docker compose up -d --wait db rabbitmq && npm run migrate && concurrently -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run worker -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.test: docker compose run --rm --build backend npm run test:container
scripts.seed: docker compose exec -T backend npm run seed --workspace backend
scripts.prod:seed: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml --env-file .env.production exec -T backend node backend/src/seed.ts
